name: Zoho Sign
description: Zoho Sign is a digital signature app for business signatories. It helps you securely sign, send, and manage documents online, streamlining your workflow and ensuring compliance with legal standards.

events.d: Submit an existing signature request to send to recipients by selecting a request ID.

events.n: When a document is sent for signature or approval
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a document is sent for signature or approval.
Get details for a specific document.
Retrieve filled form fields from a specific document.
Create a document from a template, add signers, and save as a draft or send for signature.

events.n: When a document is fully signed and approved by all recipients
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a document is fully signed and approved by all recipients.

events.n: When a document sent for signature or approval expires
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever any document sent for signature or approval expires.

events.n: When a document sent for signature or approval is recalled
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically when a document that was sent for signature or approval is recalled by the sender.

events.n: When a recipient views a document
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever any recipient views a document.

events.n: When a recipient signs a document
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever any recipient signs a document.

events.n: When a document is approved by a recipient
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a document is approved by one of its recipients.

events.n: When a recipient declines a document
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever any recipient declines a document.

events.n: When a recipient reassigns a document to another person
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically when a recipient reassigns a document to someone else for signature or approval.

events.n: When a signature or authentication email is permanently undeliverable
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically when a signature or authentication email is permanently undeliverable (hard bounces).
